stories.title: Amherst Police searching for missing vulnerable adult
stories.summary: Amherst Police are asking for the public's help after a 40-year-old woman disappeared Monday morning.

stories.title: North Tonawanda Police: Pedestrian killed after being struck by SUV
stories.summary: A pedestrian was killed Sunday night after he was hit by an SUV, according to North Tonawanda Police.

stories.title: Three hikers rescued after getting lost in Hunters Creek Park
stories.summary: The Erie County Sheriff's Office says dispatchers received a 911 call from the hikers about 25 minutes after sunset.

stories.title: Sump pump malfunction forces remote learning day for Buffalo school
stories.summary: District officials on Sunday a faulty sump pump and resulting odor prompted the temporary move to online instruction while repairs are underway.

stories.title: New York law bans subscription fees for built-in vehicle features
stories.summary: A new New York law prohibits automakers and dealers from charging subscription fees for certain features already built into vehicles.

stories.title: Buffalo Turkey Trot runners pick up race packets ahead of 131st annual race
stories.summary: Runners picked up their packets Monday ahead of the 131st annual Buffalo Turkey Trot. This year's Thanksgiving Day race features a new course

stories.title: Salvation Army in need of volunteers
stories.summary: The Salvation Army is calling on people, families, businesses, churches and community organizations to help during the Red Kettle season.

stories.title: NYS offering cooking safety tips to prevent housefires ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The New York State Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Services is offering safety tips to prevent a housefire this Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Hundreds spot fireball as asteroid piece streaks over Western New York
stories.summary: A mysterious flash over Western New York has an explanation. NASA says a piece of an asteroid about a foot wide created the fireball.

stories.title: State lawmakers prepare for upcoming Legislature session in Albany
stories.summary: Affordability and energy are still key points amid potential federal funding cut impacts.

stories.title: Tonawanda woman dies after exiting moving vehicle in Amherst, police say
stories.summary: Police continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding a fatal incident on Smith Road in Amherst that left a 38-year-old Tonawanda woman dead.

stories.title: 5 displaced after basement fire damages Buffalo home
stories.summary: Three adults and two children were displaced after a fire broke out in the basement of a Buffalo home near Military Road.
